result.topic_en: Euler notes that no power of 2 higher than 2 divides aa+1, and in Scholion 2 shows how powers of a prime 4n+1 = pp+qq are themselves sums of two coprime squares, preparing a table of solutions a for prime powers below 2000.
result.transcription:
VALDE MAGNIS. 121
altior poteſtas, veluti 4, 8, 16 etc. vnquam numeri $aa+1$ diuiſor eſſe poterit, id quod per ſe eſt manifeſtum, cum exiſtente $a$ numero impari, forma $aa+1$ ſit numerus impariter par. At de numeris primis formae $4n+1$ dantur vtique eiusmodi quadrata, quae vnitate aucta ſint per quamuis eorum poteſtatem diuiſibilia, quos idcirco inueſtigari conueniet.

Scholion 2.

Cum autem ſit $4n+1=pp+qq$, erunt omnes quoque ipſius $4n+1$ poteſtates ſummae duorum quadratorum, et quidem pluribus modis, ex quibus vero id quadratorum par ſumi conueniet, quorum radices ſunt numeri primi inter ſe. Sic cum ſit in genere $(pp+qq)(rr+ss)=(pr+qs)^2+(ps-qr)^2$, erit
$(4n+1)^2=(pp+qq)^2=4ppqq+(pp-qq)^2$
$(4n+1)^3=(pp+qq)^3=(p^3-3pqq)^2+(3ppq-q^3)^2$
$(4n+1)^4=(pp+qq)^4=(p^4-6ppqq+q^4)^2$
$+(4p^3q-4pq^3)^2$
Si ſimili modo, quo ante, valores ipſius $a$ inueſtigentur, conficietur pro poteſtatibus numerorum primorum, quae infra terminum 2000 continentur, ſequens tabula;

Tom. IX. Nou. Comm. Q Tabula

items.quote: altior poteſtas, veluti 4, 8, 16 etc. vnquam numeri $aa+1$ diuiſor eſſe poterit, id quod per ſe eſt manifeſtum, cum exiſtente $a$ numero impari, forma $aa+1$ ſit numerus impariter par.
items.english: [No] higher power [of 2], such as 4, 8, 16 etc., can ever be a divisor of the number aa+1, which is self-evident, since when a is odd, the form aa+1 is an oddly even number.

items.quote: At de numeris primis formae $4n+1$ dantur vtique eiusmodi quadrata, quae vnitate aucta ſint per quamuis eorum poteſtatem diuiſibilia, quos idcirco inueſtigari conueniet.
items.english: But for prime numbers of the form 4n+1 there certainly exist squares which, increased by one, are divisible by any power of them; these it will therefore be fitting to investigate.

items.quote: Si ſimili modo, quo ante, valores ipſius $a$ inueſtigentur, conficietur pro poteſtatibus numerorum primorum, quae infra terminum 2000 continentur, ſequens tabula;
